description.p: Strop keeps you in charge of your own writing. You write every sentence; the machine is the editor in the margin — it reads your draft the way a sharp editor would, names what isn't working as a question, and never rewrites a line.

One button asks the editor for a read at the depth you choose — developmental, line, or copy. It returns named problems as questions in the margin, never replacement text. Bring your own LLM: any OpenAI-compatible API, including a local Ollama — point it at a local model and nothing leaves your machine.

ul.li: A calm, typing-first canvas with typography handled as you write
History you own: .strop files carry the whole editing history, scrubbable like a seek bar
Nothing is lost: a compost rail for clippings, a graveyard for cut paragraphs
A cold read lays the finished draft out in book typography
Plain, portable files: one .strop file per document, Markdown in and out

screenshot.caption: Editorial diagnoses anchored in the margin — named problems asked as questions, never a rewrite
